translations.web: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”
translations.bsb: In His humiliation He was deprived of justice. Who can recount His descendants? For His life was removed from the earth.”
translations.kjv: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.
